productContent.subtitle: Basketball Shoes
productContent.description:
The wait is over. Change the game in the Caitlin 1. Her step-back creates space on demand. Her first step sets the pace. A responsive Air Zoom Turbo unit paired with Cushlon foam helps you stay smooth and controlled through every move. The innovative Nike Opticast upper delivers lightweight, locked-in support, so you can push tempo without feeling weighed down. Finished with signature details special to Caitlin, this shoe is made for hoopers who shoot without hesitation and make logo splashes the new normal.


“Caitlin Blue”

Blue represents sky-high possibilities—and Caitlin’s range. Seen as a color of imagination and inspiration, it cements her identity as limitless from anywhere.


Built by Caitlin for You

Caitlin was hands-on with our designers, obsessing to get every detail right. See it in the double-stacked Swoosh logos that nod to her initials and the three-point arc. Look closely for the 22’s and CC’s molded into the upper. Her signature pops on the heel and her logo on the midfoot reflects her range from anywhere.


Locked In for Every Move

The lightweight Nike Opticast upper uses a flexible, durable cast-PU material for an aerodynamic feel and efficient on-court movement. It’s paired with a forefoot Air Zoom Turbo unit that can bend, flex and curve for an extra spring in your step-backs.


All-Game Comfort

The Cushlon foam midsole provides a soft and responsive feel from heel to toe, while a midfoot plate brings stability through pivots and changes in direction.


Stop and Go

A rubber outsole with a “C”-inspired traction pattern has exceptional grip for quick reactions and explosive moves. Cutouts in the outsole provide a lighter feel without sacrificing precision.


Leaving Her Mark

Caitlin’s game goes wherever you step. Both shoes read “This was never a long shot,” with “Shoot More Threes” on the left and “From Anywhere” on the right.

A thick forefoot Air Zoom unit offers a different level of velocity, either on the run or out of a standstill position. It offers snappy pop when the game revs up.

The midsole is made Cushlon 3.0 foam which gives you a plush underfoot sensation, so your feet feel fresh throughout the fourth quarter.

The upper is precision molded via incorporating the flow of a lightweight foam with a dynamic external synthetic skin. The foam creates the soft, conforming aspect of the upper while the skin and molding provides the structure. That combination allows for a muscular, seamless aesthetic.
